code:
phonebook = {}                     # an empty dictionary
phonebook["Taylor"] = "555-1234"   # add a key-value pair
phonebook["Jordan"] = "555-9876"   # add another
print(phonebook)

# or, all at once:
menu = {"coffee": 3, "bagel": 2, "muffin": 4}
print(menu)
description: You can create dictionaries one pair at a time or with an initial collection of pairs.
